execution.spread_handling: Already contained in bid/ask P&L. DO NOT subtract separately.

R1_TRUE_KALMAN.description: True local-linear state-space Kalman filter. State=[level, slope]. Recursive predict/update with transition matrix, process covariance, observation covariance, innovation, Kalman gain, posterior covariance. Observation: log midprice.

R2_TRUE_GMM_REGIME.description: Real sklearn GaussianMixture. n_components=2,3. Features: [return, realized_vol, range, spread, trend_strength]. Fit on PAST only (causal expanding window). Posterior regime probabilities + training-only conditional future-return estimates as signal.

R3_TRUE_CROSS_SECTIONAL.description: Synchronized 13-pair panel. At each causal anchor: compute recent return, residual return, trend persistence for all 13 pairs. Cross-sectional z-score/ranking. Strategies: top1_vs_bottom1, top2_vs_bottom2. Each panel strategy = ONE candidate P&L column (not 13).

R4_TRUE_PCA_FACTOR.description: Real causal factor extraction from synchronized 13-pair panel returns. A: USD/common factor (beta to USD move). B: PCA first principal component (sklearn PCA, fit on past only). Generate genuine pair residuals. Dynamics: residual_momentum, residual_drift.

R5_TRUE_GRU_TCN.description: Actual trainable neural models implemented in numpy with manual backprop. GRU: 1 layer, hidden=32. Causal TCN: 2 layers, channels=32, kernel=3. Inputs: [returns, range, spread, time_features]. Contexts: 60m, 240m. Targets: 30,60,120,240m. Fixed: hidden=32, max 2 layers, 1 seed=42, lr=0.001, Adam optimizer, early stopping (patience=10 on val loss). Train on 2010-2013 only. NO architecture search.

R7_TRUE_COST_AWARE.description: Cost-aware decision layer consuming ACTUAL predictive distributions from R1 Kalman (posterior slope + uncertainty) and R2 GMM (regime-weighted expected return + uncertainty). Decision: ENTER/WAIT/ABSTAIN based on expected_move, uncertainty, current executable cost, remaining session time. No RL.

causality_requirement: For every fitted object: fit_end < prediction_start. Hard-enforced with tests.

statistics.daily_pnl: NY exit-date, one column per candidate (88 columns)
